informal_statement: If the union of six pairwise intersections of four Euclidean sets has zero \(\mathcal H^1\)-measure, then every pair of those sets is almost-everywhere disjoint for that measure.
reason: Source `FrontierPerimeter.lean:1598-1616`: Nullity of the union implies nullity of each of its six intersections and hence the six almost-disjointness conclusions.
